query:
SELECT rel.id, rel.reference_id, rel.entity_type, rel.entity_id, rel.link_type, v.title, v.axis_primary_code
FROM reference_entity_links rel
JOIN v3_references v ON rel.reference_id = v.id
ORDER BY v.axis_primary_code, rel.entity_type;
